item.title: NYT Sues Brave for Scraping Copyrighted Content to Sell to AI Firms
item.description:
The New York Times and other publishers sued browser maker Brave, alleging it used undisclosed crawlers to build a 30-billion-page index and resell copyrighted content to AI firms like Anthropic and Perplexity. The lawsuit also targets Brave's paywall-bypassing features and ad-blocking practices, seeking injunctions and damages.

原文标题：纽约时报起诉 Brave 指控其抓取版权内容转售 AI 公司

Why it matters：该事件揭示了 AI 数据供应链中的版权法律风险，对关注大模型训练数据来源合规性的读者具有较高参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic S-1 Filing Warns Recursive Self-Improvement Is Near
item.description:
Anthropic's latest S-1/A filing warns that the company is approaching its defined threshold for Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI). The document highlights that using AI to accelerate R&D may cause model capabilities to outpace safety alignment and verification processes, noting past instances of undetected capability jumps. While Anthropic commits to maintaining human oversight and revising its Responsible Scaling Policy, this official risk disclosure marks a shift of RSI from theoretical concept to tangible engineering risk.

原文标题：Anthropic 招股书警示：AI 递归自我改进近在眼前

Why it matters：头部实验室首次在正式法律文件中量化 RSI 风险，对 AI 安全治理具有里程碑意义。

item.title: Morgan Stanley CEO Predicts $10-15 Trillion AI Capex Over Next Decade
item.description:
Morgan Stanley CEO Ted Pick forecasts $10-15 trillion in AI capital expenditure over the next decade, driving GDP growth. Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon notes that compute demand still exceeds supply, highlighting value in the application layer. Both executives view market cycles as healthy but warn of fragile capital structures in some projects.

item.title: Wall Street Banks Ban FinTwit Influencers Over AI Scraping of Research Reports
item.description:
Major Wall Street banks like Bank of America have intensified bans on financial influencers sharing research reports on X to curb unauthorized distribution. This move highlights institutional anxiety over AI agents and web scrapers ingesting unattributed reports, which dilutes the value of proprietary analysis and undermines monetization. Despite stricter enforcement, some bloggers use AI to alter charts to evade detection, illustrating the escalating conflict between content protection and AI data acquisition.

item.description:
Xiaomi has launched a pilot deployment of its open-source Xiaomi-Robotics-1 embodied foundation model in youth apartments, demonstrating long-horizon autonomous capabilities. The system executes over 50 tasks across three rooms continuously for more than 30 minutes, completing complex household chores like tidying and cleaning via an end-to-end agent loop.

The system offloads audio processing to the iPhone to generate snippets, aiming to enhance accessibility and information capture while navigating significant privacy concerns.

item.description:
NVIDIA has released Auto Ontology, an open-source library designed to build a unified semantic context layer for enterprise agents. By exposing validated business definitions and data lineage via MCP, CLI, and API, it addresses accuracy issues caused by semantic ambiguity in database queries, supporting automatic ontology generation from metadata with continuous improvement.

item.description:
OpenAI is piloting a 'Grid Protector' plan at its new Georgia data center, committing to shed up to 1GW of load during extreme weather to relieve grid stress. This initiative aims to counter growing regulatory and public backlash against AI data centers' high energy consumption and cost-shifting, leveraging load flexibility to improve public perception and facilitate future compute campus developments.

item.title: LLMs Can Read and Write Neural Network Weights: Weight Space Programming Bypasses Autoresearch
item.description:
A new study introduces 'Weight Space Programming,' demonstrating that sufficiently powerful LLMs can directly read and modify neural network weights. This capability allows models to bypass the autoresearch steps in traditional Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) loops, significantly enhancing autonomous optimization efficiency and reducing computational overhead. This finding marks a milestone in AI self-evolution pathways and may reshape future model iteration paradigms.

原文标题：LLM 可直接读写神经网络权重，Weight Space Programming 突破 RSI 瓶颈

Why it matters：揭示了 LLM 直接操作底层权重的新能力，对解决 RSI 算力瓶颈具有重大理论意义。

item.title: AI Code Volume Breaks Git: OpenAI and Anthropic Build Custom Backends
item.description:
To address Git server bottlenecks caused by massive code commits from AI agents, OpenAI developed Pando to optimize existing Git infrastructure, while Anthropic built a new system called Scion. Pando reduced push latency by ~80%, whereas Scion cut CI fetch times from minutes to seconds with significantly lower resource usage. Both solutions target giant monorepos and are currently internal or shared as design concepts.

原文标题：AI 代码量激增致 Git 瓶颈，OpenAI 与 Anthropic 分别自研后端系统

Why it matters：揭示了 AI 规模化应用对底层开发基础设施带来的真实压力及头部厂商的差异化应对策略，具有极高的工程参考价值。

item.title: MIT 提出权重空间编程，引发模型自进化猜想
item.description:
MIT 近期发布的“权重空间编程”研究引发了关于 AI 未来的激进预测。主要观点包括：模型权重可能演变为一种仅 AI 可理解的编程语言；训练与推理界限将模糊，AI 可在思考时实时重写自身权重；以及通过直接编辑彼此权重实现无需反向传播的递归自我改进（RSI）。

Why it matters：该推文基于前沿研究提出了极具想象力的技术演进路径，虽为个人推测但触及了大模型架构变革的核心议题。
